_note: Plain-language positioning copy only. No scores, counts, dates or model names belong here: every number on the page comes from the repository at build time.
headline: Can AI be trusted with your money?
description: We gave AI models real problems from the world of money, like sending payouts, fixing a broken wallet and applying Nigerian tax law, and checked every answer with code.

families.name: Moving money safely
families.plain: Payouts, refunds, currency exchange and reconciling bank records, where one slip can pay someone twice or lose money.

families.name: Keeping records correct
families.plain: How a database behaves when many payments happen at the same moment, and how it rounds money and handles dates and time zones.

families.name: Following Nigerian tax law
families.plain: Applying the Nigeria Tax Act 2025 without being given the law, including rules that limit or override other rules.

steps.title: Give the AI a real problem
steps.body: Each test is written like a work ticket at a payments company.

steps.title: The AI writes its answer
steps.body: Code or figures, with no tools, no internet and no second chances.

steps.title: Code checks every detail
steps.body: A program checks the answer, item by item, against the right result. No AI judges another AI.

fairness: Every answer is checked by a program, not by another AI.
The checkers are tested too: they must reject deliberately wrong answers and accept correct ones.
Every answer, score and checker is public on GitHub.
